eligibility: All finite same-task named-primary observations with known positive total parameters, open and closed weights, no parameter ceiling; union all listed panels. Incomplete-panel peers remain eligible per task.
observation_policy: Only exactly equal model/name/size/score duplicates are coalesced with every source retained. Differing registry scores remain separate observations, with scored revision unknown. F2/AST independent reruns remain separate pinned observations and do not replace reported coordinates. Current other Vela variant is included.
dominance: A peer has no more total parameters and no lower score, with at least one strict inequality. Scores use original available floating values, not rounded display labels.

limitations: Frontier is relative to observed known-size points, not an official SOTA/rank or a matched-protocol reproduction.
Registry totals are rounded; unknown-size observations cannot be placed and remain explicitly listed.
Registry checkpoints/task revisions/precision/instructions/seed/training exposures are not established by the API; measured peer revisions remain explicit.
Full English values retain their actual evaluated component/native identities and applicability proofs; no old score is relabeled as a fresh current-native run.
